If the applicant has an old styled Handwritten Bangladeshi passport. If the applicant lost the previous handwritten passport/MRP/E-Passport but has a copy of it. In that case a lost report reference letter lodged in the UK police department will be mandatory. The applicants must have a Bangladeshi National Id card (NID) or a 17 digit online verifiable Birth Registration Certificate (English Version) to apply for an E- Passport. If the application is with a Birth Registration Certificate, the BRC must be online verifiable and must contain English data. Please verify this from https://everify.bdris.gov.bd/ We will not be able to process an E-Passport application with a Birth Certificate which is issued from Dhaka South City Corporation after 2022. Note: Please check the document requirement section to check the eligibility. Click here . Mandatory Physical Appearance Please note that Physical Appearance is mandatory for e-passport enrolment, as such, applicants must take an appointment. While you apply, the appointments will be available towards the end of the application. All the applicants regardless of any age including Child and new-born must visit the High Commission on the date of passport application submission. Application Process: Steps of e-Passport application process Step 1: Applicants must lodge their application online. Please apply online at https://epassport.gov.bd/landing . Step 2: Appointment Booking: Applicants must make an appointment before visiting the High Commission. The appointment can be booked from the same portal after you have submitted the application. Step 3: Biometric Enrolment Applicants are required to appear in person on the date and time of appointment at the High Commission to submit their fingerprint, iris scan and signature. Although children under 6 years of age will be exempted from biometrics but under 6 children including new-born must visit the High Commission on the date of passport application submission with a 3R: 89 × 127 mm (3.5 in × 5 in) size lab printed photo. Step 4: Payment: The online payment option is not applicable for Bangladeshi mission abroad. On the day of the appointment Payments should be made using a credit card/Debit Card at the E-Passport counter. We will not accept any cash or postal order payment at the counter. Step 5: After the payment is made the applicants biometric (Fingerprints, Iris) will be captured and documents will be scanned, and the applicant will be handed over an enrolment slip. Step 6: Ready and Collection: Once the application is completed the applicant will be handed over an enrolment slip which will be required during passport collection. Email Notification will be sent to the applicant once the passport is ready for collection. The collection time will be from 11.00 AM to 12.30 PM and from 2.00 PM to 4.30 PM any working day after you get the email notification or see the tracking status as ‘Your passport is ready for issuance’ Tracking the Application Applicants can track the status of their application by visiting https://epassport.gov.bd/authorization/application-status Instruction regarding Filling in the form: Applicants must lodge their applications online. Please apply online via https://epassport.gov.bd/landing . Note: The applicants must use google chrome to open this link. The applicant will require an active email ID to create an account. During the online application process, ensure you have your NID or 17-digit online verifiable birth certificate (in English) at hand. Select ‘United Kingdom’ as your application processing office and then select London. When you fill in the application form, please make sure you are applying from United Kingdom and the Bangladesh Mission will be London. Please put your Permanent address in Bangladesh and present address in United Kingdom/Ireland. We will not be able to receive any application which is applied anywhere other than London. The application will not proceed if there is in any mistake in Permanent address and Present Address. After submitting your application, download the form and the summary sheet with the barcode (PDF format). After downloading, please print the form and summary sheet with appointment schedule. To apply for e-passport, you must have either a Bangladeshi NID card or a Birth Registration Certificate (BRC) (a 17-digit signed Birth Registration certificate which is verifiable at https://everify.bdris.gov.bd/ ). In case of BRC, please make sure that verified BRC contains the necessary data, e.g. names of the applicant, Date of Birth and the parents in English and they match with the corresponding data in your application. If they do not match, please contact the office from which the BRC was issued to do the necessary correction. Your passport application may be unsuccessful if there is a mismatch between your application, previous MRP/E-Passport/Hand written passport and NID or Birth Registration Certificate data. All data should match together in order for a successful E-Passport application. Avoid using prefixes like Mr./Mrs./Ms./Dr. with your first name. Instead, write your middle name (if any) with your first name, unless your existing documents specify otherwise. All fields marked with an asterisk (*) are mandatory. Do not deviate from the information provided in your NID/BRC. Machine-Readable Passports (MRPs) may still be used as long as they are valid, so there’s no need to apply for an e-Passport if your MRP’s validity extends beyond 1 year. If any discrepancies arise between your NID and MRP or BRC and MRP, they must be corrected before proceeding with your e-Passport application. Appointment Booking: Appointment booking for Biometric enrolment is a part of the successful application submission process. Appointments will be available towards the last part of the application. An applicant must secure an appointment to successfully submit the application. There may be no appointment available on the current month when the application is lodged due to huge demand from of e-Passports. The applicant should search in the next months to get available appointment dates. Offline Payment: After selecting appointment date and time, please check that on the bottom of the page there is a ‘Offline Payment’ text which will be ‘Non-functional/Greyed Out’. This means that for London mission no online payment is available, therefore the applicant needs to pay in the counter from their Bank Cards. Applicants need to go past this page and on the next page applicants will see a ‘Continue’ button on the bottom. The applicant must need to click this ‘Continue’ button. After hitting the ‘Continue’ button the application will be finally submitted. Then on the next page applicant needs to click on their name where they will see the full application to download and application summary sheet. On the day of the appointment, the applicants are required to bring these two documents along with other supporting documents. After selecting an appointment if the applicant does not Continue to next pages, the application will freeze here and the application will not be successfully submitted on the e-PP system. This will result an unsuccessful application submission even if an appointment was secured. For detail step by step guideline to fill in the E-Passport online application please click here . Required Documents Category 1: E-Passport Application from Bangladeshi Machine-Readable Passport (MRP)/E-Passport: Apply from https://epassport.gov.bd/landing Appointment Booking: : Applicants must make an appointment before visiting the High Commission. The appointment can be booked from the same portal after you have submitted the application. On the date of appointment, the applicant needs to bring the following documents: 1. Original Bangladeshi National ID card (NID)/Original of 17-digit signed Bangladeshi Birth Registration Certificate [English version will be required]. For Birth Certificate please make sure this is online verifiable from https://everify.bdris.gov.bd/ and English data is available. Please check this link for our Student discount policy . 9. Presence of the applicant during the enrolment is mandatory regardless of age. [The photo should not be older than 3 months] (2 copies). The child should wear a colourful dress. The background of the photo must be white and the background should be cover at least 40% area of the whole photo. Both the ear of the child should be visible. 5. Parents’ original MRP / Parents’ Old styled handwritten Bangladeshi passport/ Parents’ e-Passport / Parents’ Bangladeshi National ID card (NID) is mandatory. 6. Proof of Address will be required. 7. If the applicant is married and wants to include spouses name in the passport, the applicant must bring the registered Marriage Certificate. 8. For the adult applicant (Over 18 Years of age) who never had a Bangladeshi passport need to provide a basic DBS check from the UK authority. 9. If the applicant is a British/Irish/Any other country passport holder, the original British/Irish /Any other country passport will be necessary. 10. The appointment can be booked from the same portal after you have submitted the application. On the date of appointment, the applicant needs to bring the following documents: 1. For Birth Certificate please make sure this is online verifiable from https://everify.bdris.gov.bd/ and English data is available. Please bring both the signed original Birth Registration Certificate and the verified copy. If the applicant does not have a Bangladeshi Birth Certificate, the BRC application can be made from this link: https://bhclondon.org.uk/birth-registration . 2. Print the online completed form with barcode and the summary sheet. Please apply online via https://epassport.gov.bd/landing . 3. Original of Old styled handwritten Bangladeshi passport will be required. E-Passport documents checklist on the day of your appointment at the Bangladesh High Commission, London. click here . Data Correction from Previous Passport 1. If the applicant is over 18 years of age and wants any correction in the applicants Name, Parents name, Date of Birth and place of Birth from the applicants previous MRP/EPP/Handwritten passport, as per the instructions of the Bangladesh Ministry of Home Affairs the applicant must have a Bangladeshi National ID card which will support these corrections. For the applicants who are over 18 years, we will not be able to receive any correction application based on the corrected Digital Birth Certificate. If the applicant is under 18 years of age the above correction applications will be accepted based on Digital Birth Certificate. However, these corrections are subject to the approval of the Department of immigration and Passport office Dhaka and may need a prior Police verification. Hence, the estimated processing time may be more than usual. 2. If an applicant wants to add or remove his/her spouse’s name in ePassport, then he/she must bring their registered marriage certificate or divorce certificate (Decree of Absolute/solemnised by the court) or both (removal of previous spouse name and adding new one). 3. The applicant may correct or change the emergency contact address, in that case the applicant must provide one utility bills of the emergency contact address. Very Important Instructions Before applying to avoid common mistakes 1. The application must be submitted to Bangladesh High Commission London. Please ensure you selected ‘NO’ when it asks for ‘Are you applying from Bangladesh’ and then select ‘United Kingdom/Ireland’ as your country and then select ‘London’ as your Bangladeshi mission. When the system asks for Present address, please select UK/Ireland as your present address. If you provide your present address in Bangladesh by mistake, your application will be submitted in Bangladesh. THE HIGH COMMISSION, LONDON WILL NOT BE ABLE TO RECEIVE ANY APPLICATION WHICH IS SUBMITTED IN ANY PASSPORT OFFICE IN BANGLADESH INSTEAD OF LONDON OFFICE. In that case the application must individually contact the passport office in Bangladesh and will need to cancel the application to resubmit in London. 2. If you have a previous Machine-readable passport or an E-Passport, you must select the appropriate box. If you have a handwritten passport, you must select ‘No I do not have/Handwritten passport’ box. 3. Before appearing the High Commission on the date of your appointment, please make sure your Birth Certificate/NID has the same data and spelling (specially Name, date of Birth, Place of Birth and parents name) as per your previous MRP/E-Passport/Handwritten passport. For a very small mismatch in data among Application, MRP/E-Passport with BRC/NID; the application may not be successful or may get delayed in Bangladesh. The High Commission will not be responsible for such delay or for unsuccessful application. The 17 Digit Birth Registration data must be online verifiable and need to make sure that the ENGLISH version data is available in database. The 17digit Birth Registration data can be verified from https://everify.bdris.gov.bd/ this link. 4. For applying a new Passport having a previous Bangladeshi passport is mandatory (this is exempted for the UK born only). If you are staying in UK for a long time and have lost your previous Bangladeshi Handwritten passport and you do not have at last a copy of your handwritten passport in that case Parents Bangladeshi Passport/NID, Bangladesh local chairman Nationality Certificate and Succession Certificate may be required. These applications must be supported by a Lost Police Report. However, additional documents may be required based on the interview for the passport application. The application will not be accepted if you appear only with the application and with a digital Birth Certificate. Other General Instructions: As per the recent changes, spouses name does not appear on the physical E-passport. The spouse name is only included in the database. If an applicant wants to add or remove his/her spouse’s name in ePassport database, then he/she must bring their registered marriage certificate or divorce certificate (Decree of Absolute/solemnised by the court) or both of these (removal of previous spouse name and adding new one). If someone loose his/her e-Passport and wants to make a new e-Passport, he must bring a lost report from police. Light colour dresses (such ash white, sky, ash etc.) may cause photo capturing refusal engraved in system software. Applications are cordially requested to avoid light-coloured dresses. If case of biometric capturing difficulties i.e medical lenses, finger amputation or skin problems that may demand the biometric exemption, valid and specific letter from concern Physician/NHS/GP must be shown at the time of enrolment. We will not be able to process an E-Passport application with a Birth Certificate issued from Dhaka South City Corporation after 2022. Any changes to the information provided, or undisclosed/fraudulent information, may result in potential cancellation/ delays/ extending the usual processing time. A passport application may also be cancelled if any undeclared MRP/E-Passport is found after fingerprint capture. e-Passport Fee and Mode of Payment and processing time: Offline Payment: After selecting appointment date and time, please check that on the bottom of the page there is a ‘Offline Payment’ text which will be ‘Non-functional/Greyed Out’. This means that for London mission no online payment is available, therefore the applicant needs to pay in the counter from their Bank Cards. On the date of your appointment the e-Passport fee will be taken from the counter from the applicants Bank card. The applicants are requested to keep sufficient fund for paying the fees. The High Commission does not accept any cash payment. Please do not pay in A-Challan or e-Challan. A-Challan or e-Challan is only accepted exclusively for passport office who applies in Bangladesh. After successful application submission the applicant will see E-passport fee in the application in Dollar currency. However, the actual fee that needs to be paid in the counter will be in British pound Currency. The E-Passport fee for Bangladesh High Commission London is calculated in British Pounds and is fixed considering the Dollar to Pound currency conversion fluctuation. The above fees in Pounds are calculated based on the dollar-to-pound conversion calculation. Note: Express delivery will only be possible if the applicant has a previous MRP or an E-Passport (date of issue is within last 10 years) and there is no data mismatch between Application, previous MRP/E-Passport and Birth Registration Certificate/NID. Express delivery will not be successful if there is any Police Verification is required in Bangladesh in the application process. Student Discount Policy Full-time students are eligible for discounted fees. To qualify, you must provide valid proof of studentship that clearly states your enrolment start and end dates. Acceptable documents include: School, college, or university letter Student ID card CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) letter ZIP card (as proof of student status) Please note: Proof of studentship is required regardless of age if you wish to receive a student discount. A primary/High School student should also bring the studentship proof. Part-time and ESOL students are not eligible for student discounts. Students enrolled in PhD, Post-Doctoral, or MPhil programs are not eligible for discounted fees. A full fee will be charged if acceptable documentation is not provided in paper format. Passport fees are non-refundable regardless of whether the application is rejected or withdrawn. The High Commission accepts only the Credit/Debit card payable in the counter. We do not accept any cash payment. Processing time: The processing time for an e-Passport may vary due to the thorough security and information validation procedures implemented by both the e-Passport system, Department of Immigration and Passport office, Dhaka. Regular Delivery If there is no mismatch of data between Application, MRP/EPP and between NID/BRC we expect to deliver the passport within 4 to 6 weeks’ time. Express Delivery If there is no police verification required and if there is no mismatch of data between Application, MRP/EPP and between NID/BRC we expect to deliver the passport within 21 days’ time. Note: The above time is not always guaranteed as the whole process depends on the process of Bangladesh Immigration and Passport authority. Tracking the Application Applicants can track the status of their application by visiting https://epassport.gov.bd/authorization/application-status Collecting the passport You will get an email notification on the email address that you used to create the user ID when the passport is ready for issuance. The collection time will be from 11.00 AM to 12.30 PM and from 2.00 PM to 4.30 PM any working day after you get the email notification or see the tracking status as ‘Your passport is ready for issuance’. Applicants need to bring the original delivery slip for collecting the passports. Only in the case of medical emergency an E-Passport can be collected by an authorized person. In that case the authorized person must bring his/her Bangladeshi passport/NID/BRC and signed AUTHORIZATION LETTER from the applicant. The format of AUTHORIZATION LETTER is available here: https://bhclondon.org.uk/forms-to-download Parents must collect the passport of a child. Parents must bring the original delivery receipt and Parents Bangladeshi passport/NID/BRC. What will happen on the day of your appointment: After arriving at the High Commission, the applicant needs to go to the 27 Queens gate from where the applicant needs to collect a token. Tokens will be given as per the appointment schedule. When you have the token, you need to come to the 28 Queens gate basement consular area counter 1. Your documents will be checked in the counter and payment will be taken. After the payment you need to wait for the biometric capture. When the biometric is completed, you will be handed over a delivery receipt and collection instructions. The whole process might need approximately 1 hour to complete. So, you are requested to keep enough time in your hand. We will try to serve you as per your given appointment schedule and time. However, as we deal with quite a large number of applicants this might not always possible due to the pre-existing queue, difficulties in previous applicants’ biometric capture and documents checking. Any Bangladeshi Origin British/EU National with valid resident permit in UK who has a Bangladeshi Passport/ Bangladeshi national ID card (NID)/ Bangladeshi Birth certificate can apply for NVR. - Spouse and Children of a Bangladeshi origin British/EU National can also apply for NVR subject to providing sufficient documents. - The fee is 70 Pounds. - Delivery time for in-person application is 5-7 working days and for postal the time is 21 days. - In person applications are appointment only. - NVR is never an urgent service. Documents Required for No Visa Required (NVR) Documents are required based on the following categories: 1. NVR for Who has a Bangladeshi passport or a Birth Certificate: Duly filled in online application form available at https://visa.gov.bd . A Photocopy of Bangladeshi passport or a Bangladeshi Birth Certificate or a National ID card. You must bring the original copy during in person submission. A passport size photograph attached with the filled in online application form (glued not stapled) 2. NVR for Who’s Spouse has a Bangladeshi document. Duly filled in online application form available at https:/visa.gov.bd . A Photocopy of Bangladeshi passport or a national ID Card (NID) or a Bangladeshi Birth Certificate of the spouse. The registered marriage certificate/Nikah Nama. If the marriage was conducted in the UK the council registered marriage certificate will be required. A declaration of marriage needs to be provided on the day of the application submission. The format of declaration is given here . A passport size photograph attached with the filled in online application form (glued not stapled) The applicant and the Bangladeshi spouse must be present at the High Commission on the day of appointment for interview. Note:Husbands or Wife’s NVR will not qualify the spouse for a NVR. Husband or the wife must have a Bangladeshi Passport/NID/ Bangladeshi Birth Certificate. 3. NVR for Who’s parent has a Bangladeshi document. Note: Parents NVR will not qualify the children for an NVR. Any parent must have a Bangladeshi Passport/NID/Bangladeshi Birth Certificate. Duly filled in online application form available at https:/visa.gov.bd . A Photocopy of Bangladeshi passport or a National ID Card (NID) or a Bangladeshi Birth Certificate of the parent. The Birth Certificate of the child where parents name is clearly mentioned. A passport size photograph attached with the filled in online application form (glued not stapled) Online application guideline for No Visa Required (NVR) Do not use MAC pc to fill up the form. Please DO NOT USE any special characters while filling out the address filed (such as , ; ' : - _ etc.). Please skip payment option while filling up online application. Please skip photo upload. Please select ‘Others’ in the organizations field and write ‘others’ or ‘none’ in the box which will appear at the right-hand side. No Visa Required (NVR) submission NVR can be applied either of the following two ways: Physical Presence at the High Commission with a prior appointment. By using Postal Service For APPOINTMENTS, please ensure the following steps: Submission of the online Form on https:/visa.gov.bd ; Take a print-out of the PDF version of the submitted application file. Proceed to the next step to confirm booking of appointment online from https://bhclondon.org.uk/no-visa-appointment ; and Arrive and avail service on the date of the appointment at the BHC London Office. Please bring all the documents as mentioned in the document requirement section. POSTAL APPLICATION GUIDELINES: In case of NVR APPLICATION by POST, please follow the step by step guidelines as given below: Note: We suggest you post this with the Royal mail tracking service. And please keep this tracking reference number with you for future query. A) Please fill-in the online form on https:/visa.gov.bd ; B) Take a print of the filled-in Form C) Enclose your original British/Irish Passport with the documents states in the document requirement section. D) Go to a nearby post office (Royal Mail); E) Collect a postal order of £70.00 in favor of ''Bangladesh High Commission, London'' and enclose that postal with your application form; F) Collect a self-addressed return postal envelop. The envelope should be Next Day Recorded Delivery prepaid envelope (up to two passport we require 100-gram prepaid envelope, up to five passport we require 500-gram prepaid envelope). Write your return address on it and, G) Send the entire application by post to: Bangladesh High Commission, 28 Queen's Gate London SW7 5JA. For Ireland: A) 70 Pounds Bank Draft from a Bank in favor of Bangladesh High Commission, London as Passport Fee B) Additional 15 Pound Bank Draft as postage fee. Postal Delivery: You will receive the issued NVR along with your passport after 30 business days from the date we receive your postal application.
